text.offer: Welcome to the inn, traveller. You look like you can swing a blade, and I've a problem that needs one. Giant rats have been coming in from the outskirts and getting into my stores. Thin their numbers out there, a dozen or so, and I'll make it worth your while.
text.progress: The rats are in the outskirts of Raza, just outside town.
text.complete: That should keep them out of the flour for a while. Here, for your trouble - and come back, I may have more work.
